# Reefside AI Labs

Reefside AI Labs is an organization dedicated to pushing Jellyfin further through AI. 

Jellyfin is [cautiously adopting](https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/contributing/llm-policies/) AI into its projects, but we want to see how far and fast we can push Jellyfin with a little more aggressive AI approach. This is not a full fork of Jellyfin, as we still respect the technical expertise that goes into building a project like Jellyfin. For the most part, we're going to try to develop plugins of features we'd like to see in Jellyfin, developing them fast here, allowing users to get their hands on features faster, and then using the plugins as proofs of concept, getting those features merged into the upstream later on, perhaps in a more polished format
